description: User opens a bite-sized lesson (~15 min) on a chosen topic (Public Speaking, Communication Skills, Speak Eloquently, Voice, etc.) and reads or listens to expert-narrated content; lessons are recommended based on interests and level.

Multi-day themed challenge tracks (Self-Confidence, Emotional Intelligence, Personal Development, Leadership Influence, Healthy Relationships) that string lessons into a goal-oriented program the user works through over time.
User listens to narrated lessons hands-free (commuting, exercising) covering communication, eloquence, persuasion and vocabulary; a listen-mode variant of the daily lesson.

Desktop overlay runs silently during live Zoom/Teams/Meet/Slack calls and gives in-the-moment private alerts on filler words, pacing, energy, rambling, clarity and hedging so the user self-corrects mid-conversation.

After each meeting the user reviews a recap scored out of 100 with detailed metrics (filler words, pace, inclusive language, questions, interruptions, tone, conciseness, encouragement, pausing, speakshare %) and reflects on what to improve.
User can 'practice your skills in Poised' outside of real meetings — rehearse speaking and get the same feedback metrics without a live call.

User accesses curated videos, articles and exercises from Poised-approved communication experts, organized into a personalized lesson plan / coaching plan with actionable suggestions tied to their meeting goals.
User reads aloud a series of sentences designed to test American English sounds; AI evaluates pronunciation and returns an accuracy level plus a breakdown of strong sounds and weak sounds to target.
Short daily video where a Hollywood dialect coach demonstrates a sound, mouth/tongue placement or intonation pattern; the user repeats target words aloud during the video and gets feedback.

Daily focused repetition drill on words containing the user's hardest phonemes; color-coded AI feedback highlights mispronounced sounds and gives an accuracy score, and the user repeats until correct.

User speaks through realistic conversation scenarios (job interview, ordering at a restaurant, or a custom dialogue) and the AI analyzes pronunciation, fluency, rhythm and clarity of their natural speech.
User inputs any custom sentence or phrase and the app converts it into a personalized pronunciation exercise to record and get feedback on.
User browses a reference library of individual vowel/consonant guides with audio examples and mouth-positioning tips, practicing isolated sounds.
Each day the app serves a set of personalized warmups (breathing and vocal exercises) the user watches and follows along wherever they are, to prep the voice.
Library of 100+ bite-sized follow-along video exercises teaching breathing, resonance, projection, pacing and presence techniques that the user performs aloud.
A progressive 30-day program that sequences daily exercises to gradually build the user's voice toward a chosen goal (e.g., calm, presence, projection), with reminders to keep the streak.
Scenario-specific bundles of exercises that prepare the voice for a particular high-stakes moment such as a job interview, a presentation, or recording a podcast.

exercise_name: Voice Recording with Instant Audio Feedback
description: User records themselves speaking and gets visual feedback on volume, pitch and tempo (and flags improper breathing technique); daily recordings let the user hear their own progress over time.
User creates and records self-affirmations as a vocal/confidence practice, building presence and a stronger speaking mindset.

User does a realistic mock interview with an AI interviewer that adapts to responses; role tracks include General, Software Engineer, Product Manager, UI/UX Designer, QA Engineer, and Marketer, and sessions can be tailored to a pasted job description.

User practices authentic customer-service scenarios with AI customers of varying personalities and frustration levels — handling emotional outbursts and tricky problems while the AI scores tone, empathy and clarity.
Open-ended spoken conversation practice with an AI partner to build general speaking fluency and articulation, with real-time voice analysis of pitch, tone, pace, volume and clarity.
Simulated speaking test (e.g., language exam) with detailed scoring, pronunciation tips and a personalized improvement plan, configurable to specific exam requirements.

During any simulation the AI listens live and gives granular feedback on pitch, perceived empathy/confidence, speaking pace, volume and clarity, plus a post-session evaluation report on language use, content relevance and delivery style.

User enters a topic or screenshots a match's profile and the AI produces 3 personalized openers in seconds; this does the work for the user (a crutch) rather than training them, but reveals the scenario taxonomy of dating openers.

User pastes a received message or chat screenshot and gets context-aware replies/closers tunable across 5 personalities (Funny, Flirty, Feisty, Friendly, Formal) — illustrates a tone-customization model for wit.
User selects a dating platform (Hinge/Bumble/Tinder) and inputs their best features; the AI writes a witty dating bio for them. Crutch-style generation, not a practice activity.
User answers a few questions about themselves and their ideal partner and receives a personalized critique of their current dating profile with suggested improvements.

User watches short real-life video clips (dating, business, social) inside a gamified high-stakes simulation engine and identifies what the person is signaling, training observation of nonverbal cues.
Short 5-minute daily training sessions that refresh and reinforce social-cue recognition skills to keep the user's 'Social IQ' sharp.

User practices identifying hidden emotions from facial micro-expressions, progressing from basic (e.g., Contempt) to nuanced (e.g., True Delight), learning to read involuntary signals like lip purse and shoulder shrug.
Fast-paced video challenge where the user judges whether an expression/behavior is genuine or calculated, gets instant feedback, and tracks accuracy.

Topic-organized lessons that teach cue-reading for specific contexts: business negotiations (reading hesitation, timing leverage), dating/attraction (interest vs friendliness, warning signs), and deception detection.
